fraction_basis: Weight fractions normalized over the seven modeled crystalline phases; no amorphous fraction was determined.
model_limitations: The fluorite-like component has only nine broad reflection families. Charge-balanced Pb2WO5, Pb3WO6 and disordered PbWO4 occupancy models are near-tied, so its composition and absolute weight fraction are not reliable; the submitted Pb2WO5 CIF is a nominal representative.
Monoclinic and triclinic WO3 models are near-tied. P21/c is submitted because it converged stably with the smaller interpretable cell model.
Pb3O4 and W3O8 cells were held at literature values because cell refinement was unstable; their fractions are conditional on those models.
Reported esds are refinement-statistical only and do not include phase-model uncertainty.
